reading: Hollywood actor Matthew Rhys has made history at the Emmys by becoming the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night.
He was named best lead actor in a limited series for the psychological thriller The Beast In Me , and best lead actor in a comedy for his role in Widow's Bay.
Early in his career, Rhys seriously considered enlisting in the British Army due to a significant lack of acting opportunities.
For nearly two years afterwards, he couldn't secure work, which deepened his resolve to explore alternatives.
He later received a formal communication from the army, politely declining his application, which he found ironically telling.
In 2006, Rhys moved to Hollywood and surrounded himself with fellow Welsh actors, including Michael Sheen and Ioan Gruffudd.
He affectionately called their expatriate group the "LA Tafia," reflecting their shared Welsh roots in Los Angeles.
Rhys met Keri Russell in Los Angeles at a kickball game in 2002, initially leaving a drunken message she found far from charming.
A decade later, the pair finally became an item when they starred together as Russian spies in the TV series The Americans.
Rhys owns a 1939 wooden cruiser boat, named Rarebit, which shares its name with a traditional Welsh dish of seasoned melted cheese on toast.
He admitted not foreseeing "the disaster of buying an old wooden boat" before making the purchase, highlighting the challenges of its upkeep.
The Welshman dedicated his second award to "the great and good people of Wales, who were as much a nurture as anyone else," expressing profound gratitude.
Rhys is also recognized as the voice of Han Solo in an upcoming Welsh language rendition of Star Wars.
This project, which involves translating familiar Star Wars elements into Welsh, elicited unexpected feelings for him.
He remains keen to stay connected to all things Welsh, notably taking on the role of iconic Richard Burton in a one-man show in 2025.

vocabulary.definition: A genre of fiction that explores the mental and emotional states of its characters, often creating suspense and tension through psychological elements rather than overt action.
The act of formally joining a military force or other organization.
To successfully obtain employment or a job.
Increased his determination or strengthened his firmness of purpose regarding a particular action or decision.
Revealing something significant or meaningful in a way that is contrary to what would be expected or intended, often with an element of subtle humor or profound insight.
To intentionally be in the company of certain people, often for support, shared interests, or personal growth.
Started a romantic relationship or became a recognized couple.
A type of motorboat designed for comfortable travel over water, often equipped with amenities for extended trips or overnight stays.
The process of keeping something in good condition, including maintenance, repairs, and general care.
A deep and intense feeling of thankfulness or appreciation.

entries.ja: 登場人物の精神的・感情的な状態を探求するフィクションのジャンルで、あからさまな行動よりも心理的な要素を通してサスペンスや緊張感を生み出すことが多い。
entries.ko: 등장인물의 정신적, 감정적 상태를 탐구하며, 노골적인 행동보다는 심리적 요소를 통해 서스펜스와 긴장감을 조성하는 소설의 한 장르.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种小说类型，通过探索角色心理和情感状态，通常利用心理元素而非直接的行动来营造悬念和紧张感。
entries.es: Un género de ficción que explora los estados mentales y emocionales de sus personajes, a menudo creando suspense y tensión a través de elementos psicológicos en lugar de acciones explícitas.
entries.pt-BR: Um gênero de ficção que explora os estados mentais e emocionais de seus personagens, frequentemente criando suspense e tensão através de elementos psicológicos, em vez de ações explícitas.

entries.ja: 軍隊や他の組織に正式に入隊したり、加入したりする行為。
entries.ko: 군대나 다른 조직에 공식적으로 가입하는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 正式加入军队或其他组织的行为。
entries.es: El acto de unirse formalmente a una fuerza militar o a otra organización.
entries.pt-BR: O ato de ingressar formalmente em uma força militar ou outra organização.

entries.ja: 雇用や仕事を首尾よく得る。
entries.zh-Hans: 成功获得雇佣或一份工作。
entries.es: Obtener con éxito un empleo o un puesto de trabajo.
entries.pt-BR: Obter com sucesso um emprego ou ocupação.

entries.ja: 特定の行動や決定に対する彼の決意を強めたり、目的の固さを増したりした。
entries.ko: 특정 행동이나 결정에 대한 그의 결심을 강화하거나 목적의 확고함을 증진시켰다.
entries.zh-Hans: 增加了他在某项行动或决定上的决心，或使其目的更加坚定。
entries.es: Aumentó su determinación o fortaleció su firmeza de propósito con respecto a una acción o decisión particular.
entries.pt-BR: Aumentou sua determinação ou fortaleceu sua firmeza de propósito em relação a uma ação ou decisão específica.

entries.ja: 予想されることや意図されることとは反対の方法で、しばしばほのかなユーモアや深い洞察を含みながら、何か重要または意味深いことを明らかにする様子。
entries.ko: 예상되거나 의도된 바와 달리 중요한 또는 의미 있는 무언가를 드러내는 것으로, 종종 미묘한 유머나 깊은 통찰의 요소를 포함한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以与预期或意图相反的方式揭示出重要或有意义的事物，通常带有一丝微妙的幽默感或深刻的洞察力。
entries.es: Que revela algo significativo o relevante de una manera contraria a lo que se esperaría o intentaría, a menudo con un elemento de humor sutil o profunda perspicacia.
entries.pt-BR: Que revela algo significativo ou importante de uma forma contrária ao que seria esperado ou pretendido, frequentemente com um elemento de humor sutil ou profunda percepção.

entries.ja: 支援、共通の関心事、または個人的な成長のために、意図的に特定の人々と一緒にいること。
entries.ko: 종종 지지, 공통된 관심사 또는 개인적 성장을 위해 의도적으로 특정 사람들과 함께 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 特意与某些人在一起，通常是为了获得支持、分享兴趣或促进个人成长。
entries.es: Estar intencionalmente en compañía de ciertas personas, a menudo para obtener apoyo, compartir intereses o para el crecimiento personal.
entries.pt-BR: Estar intencionalmente na companhia de certas pessoas, muitas vezes para apoio, interesses compartilhados ou crescimento pessoal.

entries.ja: 恋愛関係を始めたり、公認のカップルになったりした。
entries.zh-Hans: 开始了一段浪漫关系，或成为了公认的情侣。
entries.es: Comenzaron una relación romántica o se convirtieron en una pareja reconocida.
entries.pt-BR: Começaram um relacionamento romântico ou se tornaram um casal reconhecido.

entries.ja: 水上を快適に移動するために設計されたモーターボートの一種で、多くの場合、長期旅行や宿泊のための設備を備えている。
entries.ko: 물을 편안하게 여행하도록 설계된 모터보트의 한 종류로, 종종 장기 여행이나 숙박을 위한 편의 시설을 갖추고 있다.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种设计用于在水上舒适航行的摩托艇，通常配备设施以供长途旅行或过夜停留。
entries.es: Un tipo de lancha motora diseñada para viajar cómodamente por el agua, a menudo equipada con comodidades para viajes prolongados o estancias nocturnas.
entries.pt-BR: Um tipo de lancha projetada para viagens confortáveis na água, frequentemente equipada com comodidades para viagens prolongadas ou pernoites.

entries.ja: メンテナンス、修理、一般的な手入れを含め、何かを良好な状態に保つプロセス。
entries.ko: 유지보수, 수리 및 일반적인 관리를 포함하여 어떤 것을 좋은 상태로 유지하는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 保持某物处于良好状态的过程，包括维护、修理和一般保养。
entries.es: El proceso de mantener algo en buen estado, incluyendo mantenimiento, reparaciones y cuidado general.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de manter algo em boas condições, incluindo manutenção, reparos e cuidados gerais.

entries.ja: 深く強烈な感謝または評価の気持ち。
entries.ko: 깊고 강렬한 감사 또는 고마움의 감정.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种深沉而强烈的感谢或感激之情。
entries.es: Un sentimiento profundo e intenso de agradecimiento o aprecio.
entries.pt-BR: Um sentimento profundo e intenso de gratidão ou apreço.
